title: The contributor field
description: 80 core contributors orbit the main repo · satellite islands keep their own gravity · dotted paths = cross-contribution

props.name: data
props.description: Satellite names, finite layout coordinates, nonnegative whole contributor counts and explicit cross-contribution flags. Missing counts retain a label without people or a bridge; each dot represents one contributor.

props.name: coreContributors
props.description: Nonnegative whole count of main-repository contributors. Zero is measured absence; null or invalid values are unavailable.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
